// The sum of the squares of the odd numbers below LIMIT, pulled from a
// `gen fn` (M5).
import core::option;
const LIMIT: i64 = 200000000;

enum OddSquaresResume { Next }
machine OddSquares on OddSquaresResume -> core::option::Option<i64> {
    limit: i64,
    start Start;
    state Start {
        OddSquaresResume::Next -> { let limit: i64 = self.limit; let i: i64 = 0;
    while (i < limit) {
        if (i % 2 == 1) { goto Yield0(i) with core::option::Some(i * i); }
        i += 1;
    } goto Done with core::option::None(); },
    }
    state Yield0(__lanius_gen_i: i64) {
        OddSquaresResume::Next -> { let limit: i64 = self.limit; let i: i64 = __lanius_gen_i; { {  } i += 1; } while (i < limit) {
        if (i % 2 == 1) { goto Yield0(i) with core::option::Some(i * i); }
        i += 1;
    } goto Done with core::option::None(); },
    }
    final state Done {
        OddSquaresResume::Next -> stay with core::option::None(),
    }
}
fn odd_squares(limit: i64) -> OddSquares { return odd_squares_start(limit); }
impl OddSquares {
    fn next(&mut self) -> core::option::Option<i64> { return self.step(OddSquaresResume::Next); }
}


fn main() -> i32 {
    let it: OddSquares = odd_squares(LIMIT);
    let total: i64 = 0;
    while (true) {
        match (it.next()) {
            Some(v) -> { total += v; continue; },
            None -> { break; },
        };
    }
    print(total);
    return 0;
}
